title: Persist stuck attempts, bound retries and admit work using actual executor resources
phase: Owner registration and bounded executable-proof plan; implementation not started
independent_reviewer: dot-stuck-resource-reviewer (separate role; coordinator assigns and verifies before acceptance)

ask.by: Craig, relayed by the authorized coordinator
ask.request: Persist stuck status/count/reason for every canonical task row; park the task/operation after two recoverable failures, stop immediately on auth/permission denial, and select other eligible work. Add resource-aware admission and safe churn-stopping/cleanup support.

bug_shape: Supported coordinator plan/guard routes lack a generalized durable attempt counter and an atomic pre-dispatch reservation. Session/SHA changes can lose retry history; available executor labels are not measurements. Legacy state/queue paths must remain retired.

integration_regions: RUNBOOK.md and README.md new operational contract/usage sections
test_rules.py and test_scoped_admission.py fixture builders only if required for new ledger/resource inputs; retain existing behavioral assertions and independent probes
implementation_scope.canonical_row_projection: After acceptance of the implementation, expose stuck_status, stuck_count, stuck_reason and ledger revision for every task row in both canonical central boards and central operational registrations. Missing history is unknown/null, never fabricated zero. Preserve all existing task status, owner, evidence, ordering and pause/freeze text; an operational metadata projection does not reactivate a task.
implementation_scope.limits: Registration is not implementation admission. Fresh source-bound admission and exact-region ownership reconciliation precede shared-file edits. Freeze exact fixture/helper paths and criterion source/check bindings before executable review. Existing evidence_policy.py and retained independent regression source/evidence remain unchanged; fixture migration cannot remove or weaken existing assertions.
excluded: Game source or denied gameplay reads/auth retries
Legacy state/, queue, heartbeat or release-ledger writes
Automation edits or another route to a denied automation
External-agent contact or game-task ownership/status changes
Daemon installation, process signals, arbitrary deletion or source-history rewrite

plan: Build and test a separate project-scoped append-only attempt ledger with reserve/result/reset events, unique attempt IDs and immutable history. Use canonical repository/task/operation/normalized failure-family/target identities; session, model/provider, source SHA, aliases and timestamps cannot reset counts. Also cap the aggregate unresolved operation/target episode so relabelling a failure cannot buy a third attempt.

Integrate ledger freshness/revision and actual-executor resource evidence into the existing plan/guard and scoped proofs. Keep planning read-only. Add an explicit ledger-reservation command which revalidates the decision under a compare-and-swap lock, appends and durably flushes one reservation before any caller dispatch; it does not itself dispatch. Lost result/uncertain dispatch stays parked until reconciled.

Provide a read-only Linux resource sampler and deterministic admission decisions using executor identity, cgroup limits/usage, CPU quota/usage deltas, disk headroom and declared task/review budgets. Produce reviewable canonical-row metadata and stop/cleanup recommendations; perform no process killing or deletion.

ledger_contract.state: A new authoritative private project ledger, never the retired state/queue. Require a durable location and backend identity shared by participating sessions; a disposable workspace copy is not cross-session authority.
ledger_contract.bound: One initial recoverable failure plus one evidence-based correction; the second parks that operation/target, with no third. First auth/permission/explicit-stop denial parks immediately across executors/providers. Missing/stale/corrupt ledger or pending/uncertain reservation fails closed for the affected action; unrelated fully evidenced eligible work remains selectable.
ledger_contract.concurrency: Bind decisions to ledger/backend revision; only one compare-and-swap reservation wins. Local locking proves one-host/shared-file atomicity only. No distributed guarantee or automatic live adoption is claimed.
ledger_contract.reset: Append a substantive, evidenced resolution/reset event without erasing lifetime history. Success polls, new sessions, provider/model changes, renames, source changes and timeouts are not resets. Technical work cannot reset an auth/permission denial or explicit stop.
ledger_contract.projection: Each canonical row has persisted stuck status, observed failure count or null, sanitized reason and ledger revision. Preserve operation-specific records and lifetime history behind the row; denial and unknown states cannot become clear through a missing projection.

completion_criteria.criterion: Durable retry identity and complete canonical-row coverage.
completion_criteria.verification: Run test_attempt_ledger.py against restart/cross-session, alias/rename/provider/SHA changes, duplicate result IDs and full real-board-format inventories. Every task row projects status/count/reason/revision; malformed or missing history stays unknown. Compare all pre-existing owner/status/evidence cells byte-for-byte.

completion_criteria.criterion: Two recoverable failures park; first denial stops; another independently eligible action remains available.
completion_criteria.verification: Actual CLI negative controls cover first failure, one changed correction, second failure and rejected third reservation; family relabelling, unknown result, protected denial/reset, task-specific scope and unrelated eligible selection. Retain the failing-original control.

completion_criteria.criterion: One durable reservation wins and stale decisions cannot dispatch.
completion_criteria.verification: Use concurrent independent processes on a private scratch ledger, CAS revision races, duplicate IDs, interrupted/torn write and restart/reconciliation controls. Missing or uncertain reservations never permit replacement dispatch. Exercise reserve/result/reset commands, not compilation only.

completion_criteria.criterion: All supported aliases and scoped proofs enforce the same ledger/resource gates without weakening existing ownership/evidence rules.
completion_criteria.verification: Run test_operational_admission.py plus reviewed existing coordinator/scoped/evidence/hold-isolation suites with network and mutation routes mocked/disabled. Cover CLI and imported aliases, omitted/stale inputs and retired register-worker/queue-action; prove no legacy state mutation and no alternate automation path.

completion_criteria.criterion: Resource admission measures the actual executor and stops resource churn without inventing capacity.
completion_criteria.verification: Run test_resource_admission.py with quota-vs-host, missing/stale/wrong-executor, low-memory/disk, exhausted budget, counter reset/restart and mixed eligible-work controls; record a read-only sample from the selected executor. Unknown native/cloud/model quota remains unknown; no container-to-native capacity inference.

completion_criteria.criterion: Safe stopping/cleanup guidance and an independent exact-head result.
completion_criteria.verification: Tests require sustained repeated-operation/no-progress plus budget/resource evidence before recommending a stop; quiet heartbeat alone and Muse/foreign ownership cannot qualify. Preserve source, evidence and dirty work. Collector/proof contains no kill/unlink/cleanup execution. Separate reviewer inspects actual commands, negative controls, source diff and limits before acceptance.

recommended_setup.capability_tier: frontier: persistent admission, concurrency and ownership invariants
recommended_setup.provider_preference: Selected Game-development environment for central-only work; no rerouting of denied gameplay operations
recommended_setup.environment_and_tools: Python 3.12.14 and central GitHub connector reads verified; standard-library implementation/tests in private scratch fixtures. No installation or gameplay engine required.
recommended_setup.availability_checked: 2026-10-11: task catalog lists Astra/max; this author's selected/serving runtime identity and independent reviewer capacity are unconfirmed.
recommended_setup.attempt_budget: After actual implementation activation: one initial attempt plus at most one evidence-based correction within two hours, reserving a separate independent review. Same recoverable failure twice parks; auth/permission denial stops immediately without another route.
recommended_setup.escalation_criteria: Unresolved existing owner, missing required setup or durable backend, denied access, unsafe write scope, repeated failure or exhausted bound: park the dependent action and report another independently eligible action.
recommended_setup.verification_budget: Reserve 45 minutes inside the two-hour implementation bound for tests/correction and up to one separate hour for independent frontier/max review; do not weaken gates to meet the clock.
recommended_setup.requested_versus_confirmed: Astra/max is requested/catalog-supported, not serving-model attestation. Python and this executor's readable metrics are verified.
recommended_setup.actual_outcome: Registration only; executable proof, runtime adoption and independent acceptance pending. Model usage/billing unavailable.
